minimum_evidence_question: Decision, population, conditions, outputs, exclusions, and model influence are explicit
Model, data, code, prompts, tools, authorship, licenses, and transformations are traceable
Declared archive validates and executes in a pinned environment
Published tables, figures, and observables are reproduced within declared tolerances
Structure, assumptions, mechanisms, conservation rules, and abstractions fit the context
Code correctly implements the conceptual and mathematical model
Discretization, solver, tolerance, convergence, stochastic, and numerical error are characterized
Measurements, labels, provenance, calibration, missingness, bias, and rights are adequate
Parameter estimation avoids leakage and characterizes identifiability and equifinality
Predictions are compared with independent and relevant evidence
Influential parameters, assumptions, and inputs are characterized
Parameter, structural, numerical, measurement, and scenario uncertainty are quantified or bounded
Known failure modes, OOD behavior, edge cases, and invalid regimes are mapped
Validation evidence matches the target population, scale, device, site, or biological domain
Alternative simulator, solver, implementation, or analysis corroborates results
A party independent of the original modeler reproduces or tests the decisive result
Documentation, metadata, formats, identifiers, and licenses support independent use
Review, versioning, approval, skill expansion, and release controls are explicit
Triggers for reassessment, drift, contradiction, and revocation are operational
Every released claim maps to sufficient supporting and contradicting evidence
